sentences.en: We can conclude that this phenomenon is not related to either pollutant.
sentences.zh: 我们可以得出结论，这种现象与任何污染物质无关。

sentences.en: This smokestack is releasing greenhouse gases and other pollutants into the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 这座烟囱正在向大气中排放温室气体和其他污染物。

sentences.en: Pollutants like this derive mainly from the combustion of fuel in car engines.
sentences.zh: 这类污染物主要来源于汽车发动机燃料的燃烧。
